content: Ebo Yeisu Ta Abulilek-an He Yawal Mihomihotina Ta Ahe
Gamagalau bolo hi abulilek te Yeisu iya Mesaiya, heliya Yehoba natunau. He ebo tamala ta nunuwana-an, nasi talilau ge nulau al ta nunuwana-agil.
Inoke ta atena te sauga ebo Yehoba ta nunuwana-an ge wana logugui ta henapuan, he iya natunau al ta nunuwana-agil.
He ebo Yehoba ta nunuwana-an, wana logugui ta henapuan. Yaa wana logugui nige i pupulowan elala,
kaiwena kila Yehoba natunau gegewela panayawi wana gasisi ta pakokove. He ta abulilek Yehoba elana, inoke eliyana te panayawi wana gasisi ta pakokove.
Henalau bosowailiya panayawi wana gasisi nihi pakokove? He iyai ya te gamagalau bolo hi abulilek te Yeisu iya Yehoba Natuna.

Yeisu o iya Yeisu Keliso toto i nem panayawiya, yaka i babitaiso wewel elana ge i yaomal saliyana i lau. Nige tage i nem ya te ge i babitaiso wewel elana, yaa i nem yaka i babitaiso wewel elana ge i yaomal al saliyana i lau.
I ola al, Yayaluwa Bwabwalena i wasa tunahot Yeisu Keliso kaiwena, kaiwena Yayaluwa Bwabwalena iya tobaaba tunahot.
Inoke towasa ali gewi eton hi wasa Yeisu kaiwena:
Yayaluwa Bwabwalena, wana babitaiso wewel elana, ge wana yaomal saliyana. Ge towasa bolo eton o wali wasa i olaolaek.
Kilau ebo gamagalau bugul etega hi wasaan inoke ta abulilek-an. Yaa Yehoba wana wasa gamagalau wali wasa i bwata lake, inoke binimala ta abulilek-an. He iya iyaka i wasa Natuna kaiwena.

Henala ebo i abulilek Yehoba Natuna elana, he Yehoba wana wasa iyaka i ahe ge i kukuhikan atenaa. Yaa henala Yehoba nige i aabulilek-an, he iya Yehoba i awa tokakawi-an, kaiwena Yehoba wana wasa Natuna kaiwena nige i aabulilek-an.
He Yehoba wana wasa i ola hiwe: Yehoba yawal mihomihotina iyaka i pem elala, ge yawal ya puna heiya te Natuna.
Henala Yehoba Natuna i ahe, he iya yawal ya i ahe; henala Natuna nige i aahe, he yawal ya nige i aahe.
Nuwatu Mowamowasena
Leta ya ya leleli eliyamiu kaiwena nuwau nuku atena te yawal mihomihotina iyaka ku ahe—komiu bolo ku abulilek Yehoba Natuna elana.
Atela i matuwa nige ta pupuluwawi ta nok Yehoba elana, kaiwena ta atena te ebo iya wana nuwatu elana ta awanun bugul etega kaiwena, inoke wala awanun ni hago.
He ta atena te sauga ebo ta awanun elana wala awanun i hahago, inoke ta atena al te hauna gun iyaka ta awanuni elana, iya i pem.

Ebo komiu etega talina o ebo nuna ni kite gegi i giginol, gegi ololana yayaluwana nige ni papayaomal, he ni awanun Yehoba elana togegi o kaiwena, inoke Yehoba yawal ni pek elana. Bolo gegi hi giginol toto ololana yayaluwaliya nige ni papayaomal, he heliya baliya te ya babaa. Gegi i gan toto bosowaina gamagal yayaluwana ni payaomal,
ge nige ya babaa tage nuku awanun Yehoba elana gegi ololal o kaiwena.
Ginol nanakina gegewena he gegi, yaa gegi enuna i gan toto nige gamagal yayaluwana ni papayaomal.
Ta atena te gamagalau bolo hi tabwa Yehoba natunau nige gegi nihi mimi awaawaginoli, kaiwena Yehoba Natuna i matahikagil, inoke tonanakina Seitani nige ni pipihikagil.
Ta atena te kilau Yehoba natunau, yaa panayawi gegewena tonanakina Seitani i logugui-an.

Ta atena al te Yehoba Natuna i nem panayawi ge aatena i pem elala inoke Yabowaine tutunahotina ta atena. Kila ta minaa Yabowaine tutunahotina elana ge ta minaa Natuna Yeisu Keliso elana. Iya Yabowaine tutunahotina ge iya yawal mihomihotina puna.
Natuwau, bahi nuku kukululuek yabowaine kakakawel elal, yaa ali en nuku pek.

footnotes.text: Gegi toto bosowaina gamagal yayaluwana ni payaomal, ana sapu heiya ololana ebo ta ba Yeisu iya nige Mesaiya Yehoba Natuna i oola, o ebo toto ta atena i tunahot ta awa nanakan ge ta ba gegetoga-an. Gamagal ololana o nige wana abulilek i gagan, yaa gamagal toto i abulilek Yeisu Keliso elana, Yehoba bosowaina wana gegi gegewena ni ul yoho nige ni yayaomal.
